STEP 01 / 06
— Takes 2 Minutes —
How to Measure Yourself

Grab a soft measuring tape. Wear a fitted t-shirt. Stand straight, relaxed. Have a friend help if possible — it's more accurate than measuring solo.

1
Total Height
Stand against a wall, heels touching, head level. Mark the top of your head and measure to floor.
2
Chest Circumference
Wrap the tape horizontally around the fullest part of your chest, under the armpits. Keep tape snug, not tight.
3
Waist Width
Measure around the narrowest part of your torso, usually 1 inch above the belly button. Don't suck in.
4
Shoulder Span
Measure horizontally across the back from the outermost edge of one shoulder bone to the other.
5
Sleeve Length
From the outer shoulder bone, follow the arm down to the wrist bone. Slight bend in elbow for comfort.
6
Garment Length
From the base of your neck, measure straight down to where you'd like the shirt to end.

Frequently Asked
— Answered —
How does the bespoke (custom) option work?
Toggle 'Custom Bespoke', enter your measurements, add to cart. Our team WhatsApps you in 4 hours to confirm. Made in 7-10 working days. No extra charge.
What if the fit isn't right on a standard size?
7-day exchange on standard sizes. We schedule a free pickup. Bespoke pieces include one free alteration within 14 days.
How long does shipping take?
Standard sizes ship in 48 hours, reach metro cities in 3-4 days. Bespoke dispatches in 7-10 days. UAE in 7-9 days via DHL.
Is COD available?
Yes, COD is available across India for orders up to ₹15,000. Bespoke and international orders are prepaid only.
Do you ship to UAE / Dubai?
Yes. Flat ₹2,499 shipping, dispatched within 48 hours, delivered in 7-9 working days via DHL. All customs handled.
